notes.title: Heartwell Community Challenge Season 2: Minimum Jumps 2025
notes.content: [p][u][b]Overview:[/b][/u][/p][p]Join the second season of the Heartwell Community Challenge by submitting your runs to the "challenge-share" channel in the Discord Server linked below!  [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/sq2UuyBDG8" style="button"]Discord Server[/url][/p][p]This season's competition is a "Minimum Jumps" challenge, and up to three players can win the challenge (one for each exit to Bardolf Well)! There's two ways to compete:[/p][olist][*][p]Get the fewest jumps in any of the three exit categories to win the community challenge! Ties will be decided by whomever is the fastest![/p][/*][*][p]Get fewer jumps than the Author Stats for any exit category for bragging rights! See below for the Author Stats.[/p][list][*][p]Caria Forest: 7 Jumps, Time - 8:46[/p][/*][*][p]Polestar Highlands: 46 Jumps, Time - 10:12[/p][/*][*][p]Dorada Coast: 1 Jump, Time - 12:23 [/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][p]The rules for this competition are listed below:[/p][olist][*][p][b]How to Play:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Setup your video recording software/hardware. You will be required to provide a link to a YouTube video of your run when submitting your run to the leaderboards.[/p][/*][*][p]Start a new save file in the Heartwell Demo.  The run must be started and completed on the same save file.[/p][/*][*][p]Time for a run starts the moment that the player can move using the "W", "A", "S", or "D" keys in Bardolf Well.[/p][/*][*][p]Time for a run ends when the player reaches the Bardolf Well Exit for the category they've chosen.  [/p][/*][*][p]Count how many jumps were performed during your run, and include this number in your YouTube video's title or description.[/p][/*][*][p]Submit your run details link to the "challenge-share" channel in the Discord Server linked above![/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]What is Allowed:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]In-game glitches[/p][/*][*][p]Exiting to the Main Menu during a run[/p][/*][*][p]Exiting the Game during a run (note: the time for your run must continue even when you have exited the game)[/p][/*][*][p]Cosmetic Mods[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]What is Not Allowed:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Gameplay Effecting Mods[/p][/*][*][p]Hacks/Cheat Engines[/p][/*][*][p]Save File Editing[/p][/*][/olist][/*][/olist][p][u][b]Submission Deadline:[/b][/u][/p][p]All runs for this season must be submitted by [b]6:00 p.m. EST on Thursday November 14, 2025[/b], after which the following winners will be announced (with links to their runs):[/p][list][*][p]Fewest Jumps for the Caria Forest Exit (Ties Decided by Fastest Time)[/p][/*][*][p]Fewest Jumps for the Polestar Highlands Exit (Ties Decided by Fastest Time)[/p][/*][*][p]Fewest Jumps for the Dorada Coast Exit (Ties Decided by Fastest Time)[/p][/*][/list][p]The Winners will be announced within 2 weeks of the submission deadline closing. The next season's rule set for the Heartwell Community Challenge will also be announced within 2 Weeks of the submission deadline.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]Discord Server Notes:[/b][/u] [/p][p]In addition to submitting your runs, the best place to chat about the Heartwell Community Challenge are the "challenge-general" and "challenge-strategies" channels in the Official Antomicx Discord Server. The server link is provided above! [/p][p][/p][p]Good luck and have fun![/p]

notes.title: Winner Announced for Season 1 of the Heartwell Community Challenge!
notes.content: [p]Time to announce the winners of the first Heartwell Community Challenge! [/p][p][/p][p]We only had one runner this time, but he didn't just beat the Author time for the Caria Forest exit... he escaped Bardolf Well in under 10 minutes! Check it out below! [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="7F2h1JVBDis;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Congratulations Gretgor for becoming our first Champion of the Community Challenge! You've earned the Discord Server Role "Champion of the Community Challenge", may you wear your title well! [/p][p][/p][p]The ruleset for the next challenge will be announced shortly. Stay tuned! [/p]

notes.title: Heartwell Demo Patch 1.01 Released!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone, it's been well over a year since the last patch for the Heartwell Demo, and I'm happy to announce that the next patch is finally released! This patch incorporated the community's feedback in ways that required reworking many of Heartwell’s fundamental systems, so this is no minor patch: it's an overhaul that you made possible with your detailed and constructive feedback.[/p][list][*][p][b]Fullscreen Rework:[/b] Being able to play Heartwell in fullscreen was by far the most requested change, so I'm happy to announce that Heartwell can now be played in fullscreen mode or switched to a windowed mode from the Options Menu. This required redesigning and reprogramming nearly all of Heartwell’s UI, including creating an entirely new custom font system, but it was well worth it! If you've played the previous Heartwell Demo, then the game should start in fullscreen mode by default. If the game stays windowed despite having fullscreen mode set to "on", simply go to the settings menu and toggle fullscreen mode off and on (it should work as intended after that).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tilemap and Level Design Updates:[/b] Bardolf Well's tilemaps have been updated to be more colorful, detailed, and make it easier to see the edges of walls and different elevations! Some of the platforming sections in Bardolf Well were also adjusted slightly to make jumping to higher elevations feel more natural (i.e. removing diagonal jumps between different elevations).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased EXP from All Enemies:[/b] All normal enemies now drop 5X more EXP than they used to, making it much easier to level up and experiment with different stats and builds! The bosses drop a lot more EXP now too, but better rewards require better challenges (more on that below).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Agility Stat Buff:[/b] Previously, the Agility stat was underpowered because it only reduced the stamina costs for jumping/sprinting/dashing, actions that don't require much stamina to begin with. Now, the Agility stat has been reworked to increase the stamina regeneration rate instead. If you like using the chloranthy ring in Dark Souls, you'll love investing in the buffed Agility stat![/p][/*][*][p][b]Healing Charge Buff:[/b] The base HP recovered from healing charges has been increased from 150 HP to 250 HP since 150 HP was not even enough to fully recover from a Rattlesnake bite. This buff will let you heal the damage inflicted from one attack from all normal enemies in Bardolf Well![/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Battle Second Phases and Buffs:[/b] Besides dropping a lot more EXP, both bosses in Bardolf Well now have more HP and second phases! Don't worry, I didn’t go too overboard with these boss fights (we have the rest of the game for that), but they will be a reasonable challenge for "tutorial bosses" and reinforce important lessons to learn early on. I look forward to seeing what you think of them![/p][/*][*][p][b]Options Menu Updates:[/b] The Options Menu now allows you to switch between Fullscreen/Windowed mode and change the Lore Bit Display. In addition to the standard "Immersive" lore bit display, a new "Passive" lore bit display was added based on community feedback. The "Passive" lore bit display mode uses a smaller text box that is displayed in the bottom left corner, making it perfect for speedrunners who want lore bits to take up less screen space while they're on the move![/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Settings & Exits Menu:[/b] This brand new tab in the Manifest allows you to review specific details about your save record (chronometer, monsters defeated, etc.), adjust the game's settings, exit to the main menu, and exit the game! In addition, the Settings & Exits menu includes over 30 new lore descriptions for players to investigate and theorycraft with![/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Level Up UI:[/b] This quality of life update indicates when you've earned enough EXP to level up your Player Stat, your currently equipped Melee Weapon, or your currently equipped Ranged Weapon without opening the Manifest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased Hitbox Size for Fists Melee Swipe:[/b] The Fists melee swipe now covers a larger area, making it easier to land hits! [/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Tutorial Text in Bardolf Well for Leveling Up:[/b] When playing the Heartwell Demo for the first time, many players were unaware of how to level up using the Manifest. Adding a note about leveling up to the tutorial text for opening/closing the Manifest will provide new players enough guidance about leveling up without affecting experienced players.[/p][/*][/list][p]Finally, while there's plenty of development left to go before the full game is released, let's have fun along the way! In a separate post, I will announce the very first Heartwell Community Challenge rule set! Stay tuned![/p]
